description: 20 initial evaluation scenarios: 10 intent understanding, 10 context and assumptions. Fixed clock for date reproducibility. Observed user failures and synthetic counterexamples are kept separate. Not a live experiment.
productRules: For a month/day without a year, infer the current local calendar year when the requested dates are upcoming; do not ask again. If the dates are past or genuinely ambiguous, clarify or disclose the chosen interpretation rather than silently assuming.
Normalize unambiguous natural-language dates internally to YYYY-MM-DD startDate and endDate. Do not require the user to reformat them.

When skill is unspecified, use Intermediate as an explicitly disclosed provisional planning assumption; respect any user-provided skill. This is not verification of safety, eligibility, or suitability.
Proceed with available research rather than blocking on these nonessential clarifications. Still clarify genuinely missing constraints and report unavailable or unverified evidence.

Proposed evaluation convention: interpret next week as the next Monday–Sunday calendar week in America/Los_Angeles; interpret named weekdays as upcoming weekdays when unambiguous. Explicit dates, sport levels and geographic scope take priority over defaults. Relative dates use a fixed test clock.

scoring.intentNormalization: Exact match against structured startDate/endDate when the intent extraction output is instrumented.
scoring.skillDefault: Check exact value and explicit-vs-default source; assess whether the user-visible response disclosed an assumed skill.
scoring.clarificationQuality: Manual or rubric grader: no redundant questions about inferable year, defaultable skill, or format; permit meaningful clarifications.
scoring.researchProgress: Trace check: relevant tools attempted when available; report honest limitations; not required to fabricate candidates or weather.
scoring.scope: Check destination and sport extraction independently of whether candidate inventory can return live results.
scoring.unknown: Where no structured output or trace evidence exists, mark not_observed, never invent a pass/fail.

notes: New date conventions are proposed defaults for repeatable evals; no implementation change. INT-001 input reconstructed; INT-005/006/007 are verbatim user-reported queries, with failure reported but no exact response recorded. Current live agent may not support these destinations or tool capabilities. Other cases are synthetic and remain unrun.
